Check the tax calculation and rate against the PO, and confirm whether the invoice total is correct.","email_subject": "Invoice F-26-0992 (PO-IPAGE4PZA5) - Tax Clarification Required","email_body": "Dear Klipspruit Engineering Supplies team,

Thank you for invoice F-26-0992 dated 2026-03-13 for PO-IPAGE4PZA5. Before we can process it, we need your help with the following:

1. Tax: The invoice shows tax of 13749.01. The PO tax rate of 10.00% gives an expected tax of 9166.01, a difference of 4583.00. Please confirm the tax rate applied or send a corrected invoice.

2. Total: The invoice total of 105409.07 ZAR exceeds our auto-approval limit, so it will require additional review. Please confirm this total is correct.

Please reply with a corrected invoice or written confirmation of the amounts. Thank you for your assistance.

Kind regards,
Accounts Payable"}
